description: Open Play Console sign-in only when needed. If the saved session is still valid, this tool returns success immediately and does not open the viewer. Call session_status first. Use force_reconnect only when the user explicitly wants to wipe the saved cookie and sign in again (destructive).

force_reconnect.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete the saved session cookie for this tenant, then open the viewer for a fresh sign-in. Do not set true unless the user explicitly asks to sign out / reconnect / clear session.

name: start_browser_auth
